tickets.title: Supervise omp children: restart crashed sessions with backoff
tickets.body: Distinct user-stop vs crash (_stopping flag). On crash: jittered backoff 1s-30s, respawn via -r omp_session_file on the SAME OmpSession (keep gw_id + backlog seq), restart budget 3 consecutive (refilled on successful ready) then lifecycle=failed + reason. info()/api rows gain lifecycle/crashCount/restartReason; inject synthetic lifecycle events into the event stream so WS clients update. Env: OMPGW_RESTART_BUDGET, backoff base injectable for tests (QUEUE_RETRY_BASE_S pattern). Tests: crash->restart with resume file, budget exhaustion -> failed, user stop never restarts. Verify: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_supervisor.py -q

notes.text: Done: supervisor in bridge.py (_supervise/respawn, jittered backoff, RESTART_BUDGET env), count_children cap fix, lifecycle events, web glyph/grouping/types, docs. Tests: tests/test_supervisor.py 6/6, queue regression 8/8, svelte-check 0 errors, vitest 803 pass, build ok.

tickets.title: Idle sleep/wake instead of idle kill
tickets.body: Reaper stops the child after OMPGW_IDLE_SLEEP_SEC (default 1800) but keeps the OmpSession as lifecycle=asleep with identity (cwd/model/approval/advisor/omp_session_file). Skip sleep when busy, subscribed, pendingUi, or queue nonempty. Wake on WS attach / prompt / queue ops / any command route via _ensure_awake(). reap_dead must not drop asleep sessions; asleep rows don't count toward MAX_SESSIONS. Replace IDLE_REAP_SEC everywhere incl README/env table + API.md. Tests: sleep->wake-on-attach restores resume file, prompt wakes, busy session not slept. Verify: pytest tests/test_sleep.py -q

notes.text: Verified live: e2e all green after service restart.

tickets.title: Sessions survive gateway restart (parked registry)
tickets.body: On shutdown_all, record live/asleep sessions with an omp_session_file to ~/.omp/run/gateway-parked.json (atomic). On boot, re-register them as lifecycle=asleep rows so the rail offers one-tap wake (K-2 wake machinery). OMPGW_AUTO_RESUME=0 disables re-registration. Tests: restart gateway with parked file -> rows appear asleep. Verify: pytest tests/test_parked.py -q

tickets.title: Background jobs surface: jobs API + web jobs section
tickets.body: Confirm RPC names (getJobTree/getJobDetail/cancelJob) against rpc.md for our omp build. Thin REST routes /api/sessions/{id}/jobs[/{jid}] + POST cancel. Web: Jobs section in the session context panel (tree, per-job detail with output tail, cancel with confirm). Check tool_execution_update async detail for background badge on tool cards. Verify: pytest + bun run build in web/

notes.text: Verified live: prompted session parked on restart, restored as asleep under same gwId, woken via normal route use, deleted.

BLOCKED on omp: rpc.md has no job surface (no getJobTree/getJobDetail/cancelJob/async frames). Those are in-process SDK methods; omp-web runs the SDK inside the session process, our gateway uses --mode rpc children. Revisit when omp exposes job frames over RPC, or if sessions switch to SDK integration.

tickets.body: Extend ApprovalPanel: when pendingUi select/confirm for a tool approval exists, the composer area renders the approval (full prompt, Approve, Deny, Esc=Deny, keyboard reachable) instead of the text box. Check omp build for always-ask-cached grants before adding 'approve for session'. Verify: bun run build + manual against a write-mode session
